project.name: Boom Bap Cinematic Rise and Fall

arrangement.notes: Arrangement features a cinematic rise and fall in energy profile tailored for a mainstream Boom Bap style.

event_markers.label: start_intro
event_markers.reason: Begin intro with sample chopped drums using 'stutter' technique

event_markers.label: hook_entry
event_markers.reason: Increase drum complexity using 'reverse' samples for mainstream appeal

event_markers.label: bridge_bass_rise
event_markers.reason: Introduce 'slice' technique bass layer for cinematic tension

event_markers.label: final_hook_fx
event_markers.reason: Apply 'granular' chopped FX layer to enhance climactic energy

sound_intent.target_style: Boom Bap mainstream with cinematic mood and energy dynamics
sound_intent.sample_layer_naming: Channels named by sample chop technique like 'Stutter', 'Reverse', 'Slice', 'Granular'

routing_intent.drums: Route chopped drum samples through parallel compression bus
routing_intent.bass: Route bass sample chops with sidechain to drums
routing_intent.chords: Use reversed chord chops for atmospheric layers
routing_intent.melody: Layer melody chops with granular effects chain
routing_intent.vocal: Minimal activity, convey vocal chops sparingly
routing_intent.fx: Granular and stutter FX routed to stereo spread bus

designer_intent.focus: Create emotional cinematic dynamics in Boom Bap using distinctive sample chopping techniques
designer_intent.variation: Mainstream energy curve with controlled rise and fall

presetor_intent.preset_usage: Use presets that emphasize warmth, grit, and vintage textures suitable for Boom Bap
presetor_intent.effects: Incorporate granular and stutter effects presets on sample chop layers

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum layer using Boom Bap drum samples and apply stutter, reverse, and slice techniques for variety

bass_generator.brief: Create bass line using sliced samples focusing on smooth, cinematic rises and falls

harmony_generator.brief: Produce chord layers with chopped and reversed samples to create harmonic tension

melody_generator.brief: Design melody with sliced and granular sample chops to fit the cinematic mood

ai_designer.brief: Arrange energy curve and dynamics to support cinematic structure with mainstream Boom Bap style

presetor.brief: Apply presets that enhance vintage boom bap sound and sample chop effects

songgps.brief: Guide arrangement sections and ensure energy profile matches cinematic rise and fall

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix routing for sample chop layers emphasizing clarity and dynamic range
